'''Samhar''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forest]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was inhabited by the [[Samhari]], a [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Atlas Extra" />
